sources.summary: What is the purpose of architecture? How may it enrich human life and collectivity? Architecture of Life is the first English-language essay collection from the world-renowned architectural duo known for Fuji Kindergarten and the Roof House, among numerous other works. Beyond drawings and photos, this book embraces a philosophy that is simultaneously radical and obvious: how to make comfortable spaces and places that enhance the human experience with freedom, dignity, and joy.
